A '''sharpshooter squad''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] whose members were more accurate and skilled with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] than their fellow [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], and were often equipped with [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifles]].

==Organization==
In sharpshooter squads, the [[brevet list]] employed by other Imperial Army squad was discarded; in addition to their sharpshooter skills, troopers in the squad were cross-trained in [[demolitions]] and several other skills. Because of this, before each mission the [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] appointed the trooper with the skills most appropriate to the assignment to take the rank of [[brevet corporal]]. Each trooper was completely briefed on the mission objectives, and were considered to be skilled enough to act independently and improvise if the sergeant and brevet corporal were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in action. Officially, sharpshooter squads were not issued with [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blasters]]. However, most squads had acquired them, and their belief in their effectiveness led to the decision to issue the weapons to standard [[line squad]]s.<ref name="ISB" /> Several members of sharpshooter squads were drawn from the ranks of the [[Imperial Army Special Missions trooper/Legends|Special Missions]] forces.<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
